modelMissing: Whisper model not downloaded. Set it up in Settings → Transcription.
claudeMissing: To {task}, the app uses your Claude subscription through Claude Code, which is not installed on this computer yet. In Settings → Summary, click Install and then Sign in.

claudeTask.summary: generate the summary (the transcript is already saved)

noteGone: The note was deleted or moved out of the notes folder while the summary was being generated.
onlyMd: Only .md files in the notes folder can be opened.
outsideNotes: File outside the notes folder. Open the meeting from the Persist Notes list or change the folder in Settings → Files.
summaryFirst: Generate the summary before editing it.
projectNotFoundOutside: Project "{name}" not found. It may have been renamed or deleted outside the app.
noteRecording: This note is being recorded. Stop or discard the recording before deleting it.
speakerNameEmpty: Enter a name for the person.

voices.consent: To turn this on, confirm that you've read and agree to the use of voiceprints.
voices.selfConsent: Confirm that you want to save your voice profile before recording.
voices.selfConsentRequired: Your voice profile can only be saved with your confirmation.
voices.unavailable: Voice recognition isn't available on this computer.
voices.downloadFailed: Couldn't download the voice models (~45 MB). Check your internet connection and try again.
voices.tooLittleSpeech: Not enough speech in the recording. Read the text in a normal voice, close to the microphone, and try again.
voices.embedEmpty: Couldn't calculate the voice profile. Try again.
voices.embedFailed: Failed to calculate the voice profile.

diarization.timeout: Voice separation took too long and was canceled.
diarization.noReply: Voice separation ended without a response (code {code}). {detail}

download.offline: No connection to download {file}. Check your internet connection and try again. ({detail})
download.http: Download of {file} failed (HTTP {status}). Try again later.
download.incomplete: The download of {file} was incomplete. Try again.

calendar.notIcs: the link didn't return an ICS calendar

mcp.invalidDesktopJson: The Claude Desktop configuration file has invalid JSON. Fix it (or delete it) and try again.
mcp.rejected: Claude Code didn't accept the server: {detail} Use the manual command below.

updates.noMacFile: update doesn't include the file for this Mac
updates.noApp: the update .zip doesn't contain the app

share.offline: Can’t reach persistnotes.com. Check your internet connection and try again.
share.not_configured: Share links aren’t available in this version. Update Persist Notes.
share.rate_limited: You’ve reached the limit of 20 links per day. Try again tomorrow.
share.too_large: The summary is too large for a link (over 64 KB). Use PDF or Word.
share.server: Couldn’t finish that right now. Try again in a moment.

noteEmpty: The note is empty. Write in the notes before generating the summary.
outputSwitch: Couldn't switch the sound output. Change it in the system sound settings.
